units.translation: 新規ノートの種類スイッチャー

units.source: When an empty __TRILIUM_PH_0__Text__TRILIUM_PH_1__ note is created, a note type switcher will appear below the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Title__TRILIUM_PH_3__, at the top of the content. With the __TRILIUM_PH_4__Compact__TRILIUM_PH_5__ note title (see __TRILIUM_PH_6__Title__TRILIUM_PH_7__), it appears at the bottom of the note instead. Apart from changing the note type, it's also possible to apply a __TRILIUM_PH_8__template__TRILIUM_PH_9__:
units.translation: 空の __TRILIUM_PH_0__Text__TRILIUM_PH_1__ ノートを作成すると、__TRILIUM_PH_2__Title__TRILIUM_PH_3__ の下、コンテンツの上部にノートの種類スイッチャーが表示されます。__TRILIUM_PH_4__Compact__TRILIUM_PH_5__ ノートタイトル（__TRILIUM_PH_6__Title__TRILIUM_PH_7__ を参照）を使用している場合は、代わりにノートの下部に表示されます。ノートの種類の変更とは別に、__TRILIUM_PH_8__テンプレート__TRILIUM_PH_9__を適用することも可能です。

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Markdown__TRILIUM_PH_2__ and __TRILIUM_PH_3__ __TRILIUM_PH_4__Canvas__TRILIUM_PH_5__ switch the note to that type in one click.
units.translation: __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Markdown__TRILIUM_PH_2__ および __TRILIUM_PH_3__ __TRILIUM_PH_4__Canvas__TRILIUM_PH_5__ は、1回のクリックでノートをその種類に切り替えます。

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Code__TRILIUM_PH_2__ lists the scripting notes (__TRILIUM_PH_3__Custom CSS__TRILIUM_PH_4__, __TRILIUM_PH_5__Widget__TRILIUM_PH_6__ and __TRILIUM_PH_7__Backend script__TRILIUM_PH_8__), then the enabled code languages.
units.translation: __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Code__TRILIUM_PH_2__ は、スクリプトノート（__TRILIUM_PH_3__Custom CSS__TRILIUM_PH_4__、__TRILIUM_PH_5__Widget__TRILIUM_PH_6__、__TRILIUM_PH_7__Backend script__TRILIUM_PH_8__）と、有効になっているコード言語を一覧表示します。

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Collection__TRILIUM_PH_2__ and __TRILIUM_PH_3____TRILIUM_PH_4__Template__TRILIUM_PH_5__ list the collections and the templates.
units.translation: __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Collection__TRILIUM_PH_2__ および __TRILIUM_PH_3____TRILIUM_PH_4__Template__TRILIUM_PH_5__ は、コレクションとテンプレートを一覧表示します。

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__All types__TRILIUM_PH_2__ displays the same menu as __TRILIUM_PH_3__Insert note after__TRILIUM_PH_4__ in the __TRILIUM_PH_5__Note tree contextual menu__TRILIUM_PH_6__, with every note type and template.

Typing while the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Code__TRILIUM_PH_2__, __TRILIUM_PH_3__ __TRILIUM_PH_4__Template__TRILIUM_PH_5__ or __TRILIUM_PH_6__ __TRILIUM_PH_7__All types__TRILIUM_PH_8__ menu is open narrows it down to the matching entries.
units.translation: __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Code__TRILIUM_PH_2__、__TRILIUM_PH_3__ __TRILIUM_PH_4__Template__TRILIUM_PH_5__、または __TRILIUM_PH_6__ __TRILIUM_PH_7__All types__TRILIUM_PH_8__ メニューが開いている間にタイピングを行うと、一致する項目に絞り込まれます。

units.source: The switcher will disappear as soon as a text is entered.
units.translation: テキストが入力されるとすぐにスイッチャーは消えます。
